stem:
Julie made 25 international long-distance phone calls to London last month. The scatterplot below shows the length and cost of each phone call she made.

Cost of International Long-Distance Phone Calls

Which conclusion is best supported by the scatterplot?

options.label: A
options.text: As the length of a call increases, the cost of the call increases.

options.label: B
options.text: As the length of a call increases, the cost of the call remains the same.

options.label: C
options.text: As the length of a call increases, the cost of the call decreases.

options.label: D
options.text: There is no relationship between the length of a call and the cost of a call.

visual_elements: Scatterplot with x-axis labeled 'Length of Call (minutes)' ranging approximately from 0 to 30 and y-axis labeled 'Cost of Call (dollars)' ranging from 0 to 5. Points scattered showing no clear linear pattern.
